cohort: 755 expired neonates (out of 24,049 live births) at Mahdiyeh Hospital in Tehran, Iran, between 2015 and 2020.
finding: The most common causes of neonatal death were prematurity (23.6%), congenital anomaly (19.9%), respiratory distress syndrome (19.5%), sepsis (13.2%), and asphyxia (7%).
mod_finding: Normal vaginal delivery was associated with an early-period neonatal death rather than a later-period (OR = 2.03).
